tool_args.rationale: The positive short-window observations support gain initially but cannot distinguish a stationary response from the supplied endogenous slow-adaptation mechanism. Since the forecast horizon is 23.6, acquire the targeted slow-horizon probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon endogenous adaptation from the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The rows cover only short horizons (H=0.16–0.48), so fast/slow timescales are not identifiable for a forecast target H=23.6.
Five short-horizon observations do not identify its additional s_grad coupling and adaptation parameters.
A slow-horizon measurement is more directly discriminating for reversal and lower cost.
It is irrelevant to the identified horizon/reversal ambiguity.
